bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 14 × 14 inches, backpacks, luggage, briefcases and duffels are prohibited. Security uses walk-through metal detectors at entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: On-site paid parking in North Wynkoop lots is first come first served and available as an AXS ticket add-on; unsold spaces may be paid for at the lot. Overnight parking is not allowed.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: After shows, rideshare pickup is at the lot on the corner of 39th Street and Wynkoop Street.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession purchases are cashless. Outside food and beverages are prohibited; Guest Services can help with cashless payments.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Service animals are allowed. Guests needing alternative security screening can request an accommodation from staff.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Mission Ballroom’s FAQ and policies pages do not publish a general rule about leaving and re-entering a concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Most tickets are delivered in the AXS app; the box office opens an hour before doors on show days. The FAQ does not give a separate will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guests enter through walk-through metal detectors. A purchased Quick Pass uses a dedicated line when public doors open, but it does not give earlier admission.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
